key_insight: A deterministic multi-agent orchestration with safety gates can reduce premature diagnostic handoff and catch silent hallucinations in clinical LLM workflows.
engineering_relevance: The work is relevant for building safer healthcare AI systems by combining state-tracking constraints and uncertainty filtering instead of relying on an LLM judge.
method: Neuro-symbolic OLDCARTS gate blocks diagnosis until all required symptom dimensions are collected.
Semantic entropy uncertainty gate samples K=5 diagnostic outputs and intercepts divergent responses.
Agentic framework replaces open-ended routing with deterministic orchestration constraints.
evidence_signal: On 150 simulated test cases, the full system reached 49.3% diagnostic precision, an 11.3-point absolute gain over the unconstrained baseline, with a significant negative correlation between OLDCARTS completeness and semantic entropy (r = -0.181, p < 0.05).
watch_item: Results are based on simulated patient agents and may not fully generalize to real clinical settings or diverse patient populations.
paper_title: Agentic AI-based Framework for Mitigating Premature Diagnostic Handoff and Silent Hallucination in Healthcare Applications
